pages.text: $(l)The recipe$()$(br)Every 5 seconds the vat turns $(item)4 Bauxite Powder$() into:$(br2)$(li)$(item)1 Aluminum Ingot$(),$(li)$(item)4 Aluminum Nuggets$() with a 50%% chance,$(li)$(item)2 Aluminum Nuggets$() with a 25%% chance,$(li)$(item)500 mB Carbon Dioxide$().

On average that is one ingot plus 2.5 nuggets per batch, against a single ingot from superheated mixing.$(br2)$(l)Keep it flowing$()$(li)Feed powder into the vat with a funnel or a chute. Items can only go into the inputs.
$(li)Pull ingots and nuggets out of the output side with a funnel.$(li)$(item)Pump the carbon dioxide out.$() It lands in the output tanks, and once there is no room for another 500 mB the vat stops.

$(l)Hydrogen on the side$()$(br)The same two electrodes, without heat, turn $(item)1000 mB Water$() into $(item)500 mB Hydrogen$(). If you send water into your aluminium vat, it will make hydrogen too.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
